## Cleanup Scope

Which slice of the backlog does this pass cover? (e.g. open bugs older than 90 days, unlabeled feature requests, duplicate reports in one subsystem)

## Items to Triage

Link each issue in scope with `#<issue-number>`:

- [ ] #<issue> — <one-line summary>
- [ ] #<issue> — <one-line summary>

## Proposed Actions

State the outcome for each item so the pass stays auditable:

- #<issue> — close / relabel / split / promote (reason)
- #<issue> — close / relabel / split / promote (reason)

## Impact

Why does this cleanup matter? (faster prioritization, accurate labels, fewer duplicate reports, smaller honest backlog, ...)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every listed issue carries exactly one primary type label (`bug`, `enhancement`, `documentation`, `question`)
- [ ] Duplicates, invalid reports, and wontfix items are closed with a comment explaining why
- [ ] Labels used match the triage vocabulary documented in CONTRIBUTING.md

## Additional Context

Any notes, links, or screenshots that help the triage pass.
